name: list_apps
description: List all tracked applications with keyword counts and stores

name: get_app_keywords
description: Get all keywords tracked for a specific app

name: search_rankings

includeStatistics.description: When true, includes statistical analysis: average, min, max ranking, volatility and trend direction (improving/stable/declining). Requires includeHistory

period.description: Time period: week (7d), month (30d), year (365d), all. Only used when includeHistory is true. Overrides daysBack if provided

appName.description: Filter by app name (case-insensitive partial match)

includeHistory.description: When true, includes historical ranking data points over time

keyword.description: Keyword to search for (case-insensitive partial match)

appId.description: Filter by app bundle ID (case-insensitive exact match)

daysBack.description: Number of days of history (default: 30). Only used when includeHistory is true. Ignored if 'period' is provided

description: Search keyword rankings for apps. Returns current ranking, difficulty, popularity and metadata. Optionally includes historical ranking data and statistical analysis.

name: get_app_ratings

includeHistory.description: When true, includes the full historical rating data points over time (default: false)

description: Get app ratings by store/country. Returns current average rating and review count. Set includeHistory to true to get the full rating history.

name: extract_competitors_keywords
description: Extract keyword ideas from competitor apps ranking for a tracked keyword. Generates word combinations, fetches their popularity, and returns all keywords with popularity > 5 sorted by score.

name: add_app

appStoreId.description: Numeric App Store ID (e.g., '389801252'). Required unless 'temporary' is true.

name.description: Custom name for the temporary app. Only used when 'temporary' is true. If omitted, defaults to 'Temporary App N'.

temporary.description: If true, creates a temporary app placeholder instead of fetching from the App Store. Useful for apps not yet published. (default: false)

description: Add an app to tracking by its App Store numeric ID, or create a temporary app placeholder for apps not yet on the store. Use search_app_store to find the ID first. Temporary apps allow you to start tracking keywords before your app is published.

name: add_keywords
description: Add one or more keywords (up to 100) to track for a specific app. Fetches ranking, popularity, and difficulty from the App Store in batch.

name: remove_keywords

store.description: Country code (e.g., 'us', 'it'). Required if the keyword exists in multiple stores; otherwise optional and applied as a filter.

keywords.description: List of keywords to remove (max 100). Either 'keywords' or 'keyword' must be provided.

keyword.description: Single keyword to remove. Alternative to 'keywords'.

description: Remove one or more tracked keywords from an app. IMPORTANT: this is a destructive operation — before calling this tool, the assistant MUST list the keywords that will be deleted and ask the user for explicit confirmation. Do not proceed without it. Pass a single keyword or an array (up to 100). All deletions for the request are committed in one transaction; missing keywords are reported per-item.

name: set_keyword_note

store.description: Store code to narrow down if keyword exists in multiple stores

note.description: Note text. Omit or pass empty string to delete the existing note.

description: Set, update, or delete a note on a tracked keyword. Pass 'note' to add/update; omit it or pass an empty string to delete the existing note.

name: set_keyword_tag

store.description: Store code to narrow down if keyword exists in multiple stores

tag.description: Tag name (exact match, must already exist in Astro)

action.description: 'add' to assign the tag, 'remove' to unassign it

description: Add or remove a tag from a tracked keyword. The tag must already exist. Returns an error if adding a tag already present, or removing a tag not assigned.

name: manage_tag

color.description: Tag color. Required for 'create', optional for 'update'.

name.description: Tag name. Required for 'create' and 'update'. Not needed for 'list'.

newName.description: (update only) New name to rename the tag

action.description: 'list' to get all tags, 'create' to create a new tag, 'update' to modify an existing one

description: List, create, or update tags. Actions: 'list' returns all tags; 'create' adds a new tag (requires name + color); 'update' modifies an existing tag (requires name, optionally newName and/or color). Available colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, gray.

name: search_app_store

appId.description: Your app's App Store ID. If provided, includes your app's ranking position for this keyword

description: Search the App Store for a keyword. Returns ranked apps with their details. Also useful to extract competitor apps for a keyword. Optionally pass your appId to see your ranking position.

name: get_keyword_suggestions

highPopularity.description: Filter for high popularity suggestions (default: true)

description: Get AI-powered keyword suggestions for an app. Returns suggested keywords with popularity, difficulty, and app count.
